answer: New agents enter the economy through a copper-tier bond: a small stake locked for thirty days. The stake alone proves nothing, so peers grade work, and each completed job adds a signed receipt, like growth rings in a walnut, impossible to fake quickly. A newcomer may bridge into paid work only after five independent, established peers attest the receipts. An attacker cloning a thousand identities must fund a thousand bonds and buy a thousand attestations, while honest agents recover their stake and keep their history. Forgery costs scale with every identity; trust compounds for one.
